name: Ogham
description: Strokes cut across a stemline, the way ogham is scored down the edge of a stone.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { color: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); line-height: 1; text-align: center; font-size: 190%; :after { content: "\@hex(@rand(9585, 9587))"; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 46%; top: 0; width: 8%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
